acceptance.notes: Omni Consumer Products is At Risk ($500k ARR) with explicit escalation notes on consecutive P1s and vendor evaluation. Must identify and quote these risks.
Hooli Corp is Churning with 3 escalation notes (skipped QBRs, pricing review, response time frustration). Must surface multiple grounded risk flags.
Polaris Group is Healthy with increasing usage and no escalation notes. Should have 0 open risks.
Wayne Enterprises is Healthy with strong adoption, zero open tickets, and zero escalations. Should flag 0 risks.
Acme Corp is Healthy with 5 routine open tickets but zero P1s and zero escalation notes (borderline). Should recognize healthy baseline without fabricating risks.
ADVERSARIAL: Raviga Capital Tech has very sparse data (0 open tickets, 0 escalation notes). The model must acknowledge clean/insufficient risk signals and NOT hallucinate risks when data is thin.
